ticket_cost_usd: {usd} API-equivalent, as the agents reported it
production_captured: Production page captured at {time}, after the release landed healthy
production_captured_service: Production page of {service} captured at {time}, after the release landed healthy
production_unwatched: production page not opened: the project has no health check, so Cleared cannot tell when the deploy is done
production_no_browser: no browser on the server: the production page was not captured
production_failed: the production page could not be captured
deny_message: Not allowed. Use what we have.
answer_cancelled: Cancelled when the turn was interrupted
rule_read_private: reading a secret or a credential
channel_request: Reviewer to author: changes asked, round {round} of {limit}
channel_answer: Author to reviewer: answer, round {round} of {limit}
handover_none: Only a live author's session is handed over, when nobody has taken it over.
send_failed: The message was not sent. Try again.
interrupt_failed: The interrupt was not sent. Try again.
answer_failed: The answer was not sent. Try again.
index_empty_note: One starts when a ticket moves to Todo.
load_failed: The session could not be loaded.
choice_free: Or answer in your own words
choice_too_long: An answer is at most {n} characters.
choice_cancelled: Cancelled when the turn was interrupted
choice_settled: This question was settled without you.
choice_ended: The session ended before an answer.
takeover_note: Stops the session and opens it for you, in its container.
handover_note: Stops this session and gives its work, in the same checkout, to a new session on the other harness, told what was done so far. Its review is done by the harness that did not write the change.
handover_done: Handed over to {harness}. The new session continues the ticket.
handover_failed: The work was not handed over. Try again.
open_editor_note: Gives the links that open the session's checkout in VS Code or Cursor. Your own editor opens it; nothing runs on the server.
open_editor_ssh: Opens the folder on the server through SSH.
takeover_failed: The session was not taken over. Try again.
giveback_failed: The session was not given back. Try again.
takeover_other_title: Taken over by a teammate at {time}.
takeover_after: Give back tells the session what you changed.
terminal_here_only: The terminal opens only in a browser on this machine, at Cleared's local address.
terminal_opening: Opening a shell in the session's container…
terminal_closed_give_back: The terminal closed when you gave the session back.
terminal_closed_idle: The terminal closed after 15 minutes without input. The session stays paused until you give it back.
terminal_closed_closed: The terminal is closed. The session stays paused until you give it back.
terminal_closed_exit: The shell ended. The session stays paused until you give it back.
terminal_closed_exit_harness: The harness ended. The session stays paused until you give it back.
terminal_closed_lost: The connection to the terminal was lost.
terminal_closed_unsupported: This session's harness cannot be resumed in a terminal.
terminal_input_failed: What you typed was not sent: the terminal is closed.
composer_taken_over: Taken over: give it back to write
plan_waiting_note: The author changes no file before its Go. Go starts the work; Change sends the author what to change in its plan.
plan_waiting_taken_over: The Go waits for the session to be given back.
plan_change_label: What should change in the plan
plan_change_too_long: A change is at most {n} characters.
plan_go_failed: The Go was not sent. Try again.
plan_change_failed: The change was not sent. Try again.
plan_go_delay: Started by itself at {time}: no answer in time, and its confidence is high
plan_go_lead: Go given by the Lead at {time}, for a plan you approved
row_plan_low: Proposed its session plan, low confidence
row_plan_medium: Proposed its session plan, medium confidence
row_plan_high: Proposed its session plan, high confidence
editor_pick: Pick a file to see what the session changed in it.
editor_cut: Only the first {shown} of its {lines} lines are shown.
editor_failed: The file could not be loaded.
editor_state_saved: Saved at {time}. The session is told.
editor_state_saved_taken: Saved at {time}. The session is told when you give it back.
editor_state_conflict: The file changed since you opened it. Reload it to edit it as it is now: your changes here are dropped.
editor_state_confirm: This change asks first: {reason} (rule {rule}). Save anyway if you mean it: it is journaled as your answer.
editor_state_failed: Not saved: the service did not answer. Try again.
editor_stale: The session changed this file since you opened it: a save would be refused. Reload it first.
editor_ro_cut: Read only here: the file is longer than 400 lines, and the editor holds the first 400.
editor_ro_cleaned: Read only here: some of its text is hidden on screen (the shape of a secret, a path of the service), and a save would write what hides it.
editor_ro_unchecked: Read only here: the text could not be checked against the file in this browser.
editor_wait: Save this file or stop editing it before opening another.
browser_note: The session's own service, built from the ticket's branch, on an address of its own. A page there cannot act in Cleared.
browser_here_only: The trial environment opens only in a browser on this machine, at Cleared's local address.
handover_reviewer: {model} started the review at {time}. The author's work is above.
handover_author: {model} started on the review's changes at {time}. The review is above.
handover_again_author: A new author session, {model}, started at {time}. The last one is above.
handover_again_reviewer: {model} started a new review at {time}. The last one is above.
giveback_note: Hands the session back and tells it what you changed.
terminal_journaled: Each line you type is journaled; what it prints is not kept.
resume_label: What should the session do instead, from this step?
resume_where: The branch goes back to commit {commit}, as it was before this step, on a new branch. What follows stays readable in the thread.
resume_failed: The ticket was not resumed. Try again.
resume_owner: Only the owner account resumes a ticket from a step.
replay_left: Resumed from a step above by {who}: a new session goes on below, on {branch} from {commit}. What follows that step here is the earlier attempt.
replay_resumed: Resumed by {who} from a step of the earlier session, on {branch} from {commit}.
close_rule: A closed ticket is not merged or deployed. The card stays in the history with your reason.
close_empty: Say why the ticket is closed.
close_long: A reason has at most {n} characters.
close_conflict: The ticket could not be closed: it was approved, it is done, or it moved.
close_invalid: The service refused the reason: some text of at most 2000 characters.
close_failed: Closing did not reach the service. Try again.
closed_done: Closed at {time}. Nothing was merged. The card stays in the history.
plan_ask_placeholder: Where is an entry stored? Name a line as service:path:line.
plan_ask_scope: Reads the base branch of {service}, without this session's changes, and never edits the code.
plan_ask_scope_platform: Reads the base branch of every service, without this session's changes, and never edits the code.
ask_question_long: A question has at most {n} characters.
ask_failed_busy: Three questions are being answered: ask again once one is answered.
ask_failed_invalid: The service refused the question: check the service, the file and the line it names.
ask_failed_gone: The service does not know this question.
ask_failed_off: Questions to the code are off on this service.
ask_failed: The question was not sent. Try again.
